# Portalix API

Portalix is a SaaS platform that lets organisations (orgs) create client-facing service portals. Each org can have multiple portals; each portal has its own request types and requests. Clients have one account per org and can access any portal within that org.

## Core concepts

- **Org**: the organisation that owns the Portalix instance (e.g. a city hall). Created on sign-up.
- **Portal**: a named service channel within an org (e.g. "Environmental Licensing"). Identified by a slug in the URL.
- **Request type**: a category of service a client can request (e.g. "Installation Permit").
- **Request**: a client submission tied to a portal and a request type.
- **Org user**: an internal staff member who processes requests. Has org-level and/or portal-level roles.
- **Client**: a member of the public with one account per org, can sign in to any portal under that org.
- **Role**: unified role model — roles have a `level` field (`"org"` or `"portal"`). Portal roles are assigned to org users per portal via `POST /org/portals/{portal_id}/users`.

## Authentication

All endpoints (except sign-up, verify-email, sign-in, and forgot-password) require a Bearer JWT in the `Authorization` header.

Org users authenticate via `POST /auth/sign-in` and receive an `access_token` (JWT) and a `refresh_token`.

Clients authenticate via `POST /citizen/{org_slug}/{portal_slug}/auth/sign-in` and receive an `access_token` scoped to that portal session.

Tokens are invalidated on password reset. Refresh tokens issued before a password reset will be rejected.

Use `POST /auth/refresh` or `POST /citizen/{org_slug}/{portal_slug}/auth/refresh` to renew tokens.

## Base URL

https://portalu-production.up.railway.app/api/v1

## Guides

- [Flow 1 — Org Setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tassiobs/portalix-docs/v1.0/docs/Getting%20Started/flow-1-org-setup.md): sign up, verify email, create a portal, create request types
- [Flow 2 — Internal User Onboarding](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tassiobs/portalix-docs/v1.0/docs/Getting%20Started/flow-2-internal-user-onboarding.md): invite a user, assign org role, grant portal access
- [Flow 3 — Client Submitting a Request](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tassiobs/portalix-docs/v1.0/docs/Getting%20Started/flow-3-citizen-submitting-a-request.md): client sign-up, verify email, sign in, browse request types, submit a request
- [Flow 4 — Processing a Request](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tassiobs/portalix-docs/v1.0/docs/Getting%20Started/flow-4-processing-a-request.md): list requests, update request status

## Key endpoints

### Org auth
- POST /auth/sign-up — create org + super admin (requires org_name, name, email, password). Returns 503 if email delivery fails — nothing is created.
- POST /auth/verify-email — verify email with token from email link
- POST /auth/resend-verification — resend verification email (requires email)
- POST /auth/sign-in — sign in, returns access_token + refresh_token + user
- POST /auth/refresh — refresh tokens (rejected if issued before password reset)
- POST /auth/forgot-password — send password reset link (always returns generic message)
- POST /auth/reset-password — reset password with token; invalidates all existing sessions
- POST /auth/accept-invite — accept invitation and set password
- POST /auth/sign-out — invalidate refresh token and session
- GET /auth/me — get current org user profile (includes org_roles and portal_roles)

### Portals (org admin)
- GET /org/portals — list portals
- POST /org/portals — create portal (requires name; returns id and slug)
- PATCH /org/portals/{portal_id} — update portal (requires portal.settings:manage)
- DELETE /org/portals/{portal_id} — delete portal
- POST /org/portals/{portal_id}/users — assign org user to portal with role_id (requires portal.users:manage)
- DELETE /org/portals/{portal_id}/users/{user_id} — remove user from portal (requires portal.users:manage)
- GET /org/portals/permissions — list all available portal-level permission keys

### Request types (org admin)
- GET /org/portals/{portal_id}/request-types — list request types (requires portal.request_types:manage)
- POST /org/portals/{portal_id}/request-types — create request type
- PATCH /org/portals/{portal_id}/request-types/{rt_id} — update
- DELETE /org/portals/{portal_id}/request-types/{rt_id} — delete

### Requests (org admin)
- GET /org/portals/{portal_id}/requests — list all requests on portal (requires portal.requests:read)
- PATCH /org/portals/{portal_id}/requests/{request_id} — update status or title (requires portal.requests:update)

### Client auth (scoped to org via portal URL)
- POST /citizen/{org_slug}/{portal_slug}/auth/sign-up — create client account for the org. Returns 503 if email delivery fails.
- POST /citizen/{org_slug}/{portal_slug}/auth/verify-email — verify email with token from email link
- POST /citizen/{org_slug}/{portal_slug}/auth/sign-in — sign in, returns access_token + refresh_token + citizen
- GET /citizen/{org_slug}/{portal_slug}/auth/me — get current client profile (requires auth)
- POST /citizen/{org_slug}/{portal_slug}/auth/refresh — refresh tokens
- POST /citizen/{org_slug}/{portal_slug}/auth/sign-out — invalidate session
- POST /citizen/{org_slug}/{portal_slug}/auth/forgot-password — send reset link (always generic response)
- POST /citizen/{org_slug}/{portal_slug}/auth/reset-password — reset password; invalidates existing sessions

### Client requests (scoped to portal session)
- GET /citizen/{org_slug}/{portal_slug}/request-types — list available request types (no auth required)
- GET /citizen/{org_slug}/{portal_slug}/requests — list my requests (includes request_type_name)
- POST /citizen/{org_slug}/{portal_slug}/requests — submit a request (requires request_type_id, title)
- GET /citizen/{org_slug}/{portal_slug}/requests/{request_id} — get a specific request

### Org users
- GET /org/users — list users with org_roles and portal_roles
- POST /org/users — invite a user (requires email; sends invitation email; returns 503 if email fails)
- GET /org/users/{user_id} — get user
- PATCH /org/users/{user_id} — update user (name, status)
- GET /org/users/{user_id}/roles — list all role assignments (org-level and portal-level)
- POST /org/users/{user_id}/roles — assign org role
- DELETE /org/users/{user_id}/roles/{role_id} — remove org role

### Roles (IAM)
- GET /org/roles — list all roles (use ?level=portal to filter portal roles)
- POST /org/roles — create role (requires level: "org" | "portal", name, permissions[])
- PATCH /org/roles/{role_id} — update role
- DELETE /org/roles/{role_id} — delete role
- GET /org/portals/permissions — list portal-level permission keys

### Org settings
- GET /org/settings — get org settings
- PATCH /org/settings — update org settings
